function.description: Evaluate one PromQL range query against the registered target's Prometheus inside a query window you may choose within the authorized window. The result is the raw response series: data.result holds one entry per label set with [timestamp, value] points. Counters such as *_calls_total are cumulative. Wrap a counter in rate() or increase() for per-window activity. A range selector may be at most the query window length. A point at time t with range selector [r] covers [t - r, t]. A subquery (inner)[a:b] covers a plus what inner covers, and that total may be at most the query window length. Every point covers samples inside the query window only. No point reads samples from before the query window. The expression's total lookback is its longest range selector, or a subquery range plus its inner lookback. The first point is at the query window start plus the total lookback. The view reports the total lookback as lookback_seconds and the earliest instant read as lookback_start_at. source_start_at is the first returned sample inside the query window. A whole-window total, maximum or minimum comes from one evaluation of a range selector equal to the query window's length in seconds, written as increase(x[Ws]), max_over_time(x[Ws]) or min_over_time(x[Ws]) where W is that many seconds. Do not compute totals, maxima or minima from the point list yourself. A range selector longer than the query window is refused. offset is refused. @ is refused. A result whose whole view exceeds 25,000 tokens is refused with RESULT_TOO_LARGE and no series are returned. The refusal gives series_count, total_points, label_cardinality (label names with their number of values) and a topk suggestion; when it also carries an evidence_id the whole result was kept, and read_evidence reads its series in ranges. Otherwise narrow the query window, add label filters or aggregate. A series that is not returned is unknown, not zero. A returned series does not by itself prove the service is healthy or unhealthy. Available metrics include traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name,span_name,status_code}, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name,rpc_service,rpc_method,rpc_grpc_status_code}, rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket, app_payment_transactions_total, http_server_request_duration_seconds_count. Kubernetes object state from kube-state-metrics is also available: kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace,deployment}, kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace,deployment}, kube_replicaset_owner{namespace,replicaset,owner_kind,owner_name}, kube_pod_owner{namespace,pod,uid,owner_kind,owner_name}, kube_pod_container_info{namespace,pod,uid,image_id}. These series use the namespace, deployment, replicaset, pod and owner_name labels, not service_name. A configuration-only deployment keeps the same image digest in image_id. Such a deployment shows as a new ReplicaSet series in kube_replicaset_owner and as kube_pod_owner owner_name moving to that ReplicaSet. For a metric or label not listed here, discover it with get_metric_names or get_label_values first, and use only metric names, label names and label values you have seen returned by a tool or that are listed here.
function.name: metrics_range_query

start.description: Absolute ISO-8601 start of the query window. Give both start and end, or neither. Must lie inside the authorized window; a query window outside it is refused and the refusal states the authorized window.

function.description: Search the registered target's Jaeger for traces of one service inside a query window you may choose within the authorized window, and return a projected sample of their spans: spans of the requested service first, then spans with an error status tag, then the longest, each with trace_id, span_id, service, operation, start_us, duration_us, status tags, parent references and up to 4 clipped error detail fields. A result whose whole view exceeds 25,000 tokens is refused with RESULT_TOO_LARGE and no spans are returned; narrow the time window or lower limit. traces_requested is the number of traces asked of the backend. backend_traces_returned is the number of traces the backend returned. backend_spans_returned is the number of spans in those traces. spans_shown is the number of span rows in this view. spans_omitted is the number of backend spans not shown because the adapter sampled them out. span_groups summarizes the shown spans by (service, operation): rows, status counts, error_rows and duration_us_min/max, computed from every span in spans_shown. incomplete_reason states why incomplete is true, or is null. status_state is recorded when the row has at least one status tag and not_recorded when it has none. not_recorded means the span carries no status tag, which is Unset in OTel terms, not status code 0 and not OK. This is a biased sample, not the complete trace graph or a failure rate: an omitted span is unknown, an error detail applies only to the span it is shown on, and an empty result means no trace of that service was returned for the query window, not that the service made no calls. Available services: ["accounting", "ad", "cart", "checkout", "currency", "email", "fraud-detection", "frontend", "frontend-proxy", "image-provider", "kafka", "load-generator", "payment", "product-catalog", "quote", "recommendation", "shipping"]; any other value returns an error.
function.name: traces_search

function.description: List metric names in the registered target's Prometheus that have series matching a selector inside a query window you may choose within the authorized window. Use it to discover which metrics exist before writing a metrics_range_query expression. content is the list of metric names returned; it carries no values, types, descriptions or label sets. At most 100 names are returned. When more exist, the first 100 are returned, incomplete is true and incomplete_reason says to narrow the match selector; incomplete is also true whenever Prometheus returned any warning. limit in the view is that fixed 100 cap; you cannot change it. Combine several patterns in one call with a regular expression alternation, for example {__name__=~"rpc_.*|http_.*"} or {service_name=~"checkout|payment"}. A result whose whole view exceeds 25,000 tokens is refused with RESULT_TOO_LARGE and no names are returned. A listed name does not prove the metric has samples in the query window, nor anything about its values or the service's health. A name that is not listed is unknown, not proven absent: the list may be cut at 100 or limited by the selector and window.

function.description: Read a range of rows from a result this investigation kept because its whole view exceeded 25,000 tokens.
